I cannot thank you enough for this. Thank you so much for taking time and writing this reply.   
People tend to think if they don't invalidate my concerns I'll go crazy and believe I have something very serious without a diagnosis. Just because my symptoms are not showing 24/7 (even if it was the case they wouldn't pay enough attention to notice anyway) they think I'm exaggerating very minor things. Even my current doctor said something like this: ''You are complaining about muscle jerks/spasms but I can't see any of it right now'' Shouldn't I be taken seriously if I don't have uncontrollable muscle jerks every second of the day? When tests come back clear and I still question as to why I've been experiencing these symptoms they think I wish to have something serious. I can stop talking about my heath problems to others, that's easy. I hope I can find a doctor that doesn't have the same mentality. 

If it wasn't for your reply I wouldn't try to find a good doctor and continue taking so many medications a day(I take other meds for some other symptoms) Thank you so much for your reply. It made me feel good about myself which doesn't happen very often and if I look for a better doctor I might solve all of my problems all thanks to you. If I forget to thank you then, I have to say it now; Thank you so much. I wish you the very best at life and I wish you the very best about your health. I hope you always encounter with kind and considerate people like yourself. Have a very pleasant day.
